fields.label: Statement summary
fields.text: If max_{j,k} 2 P_MC(chi^k_j) < 1, N gamma_det <= n <= N, and 0 < P_noqub,theta < nu_unf < gamma_det (1 - gamma_err/(1 - P_bound)), with max 2 P_MC <= P_bound < 1, then eps_unf = sum_{l=0}^{floor(N(1-nu_unf))} C(N,l)(1-P_noqub,theta)^l P_noqub,theta^{N-l} + sum_{l=0}^{floor(n gamma_err)} C(n - floor(N nu_unf), l)(1-P_bound)^l P_bound^{n - floor(N nu_unf) - l}.

fields.label: Recomputation
fields.text: RECOMPUTED_BY_LANE_A: eq.(28), 1-(1-P_wrong)^6 + eps_unf (1-P_wrong)^6 = 5.507e-9 (reported 5.52e-9). Eq.(27) with K=7 gives 1.82e-11 (reported 2.1e-11). The reported values are larger, so this looks like conservative rounding rather than an unsafe error. Flagged for lane D, not treated as an erratum.
